arxiv-2210-05664.title: Social Influence Dialogue Systems: A Survey of Datasets and Models For Social Influence Tasks

arxiv-2210-05664.description: Abstract Dialogue systems capable of social influence such as persuasion, negotiation, and therapy, are essential for extending the use of technology to numerous realistic scenarios. arxiv-2303-07685.description: Abstract Traffic flow forecasting is challenging due to the intricate spatio-temporal correlations in traffic flow data.
